easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
When Hajar dies, Yedora triggers, returning Hajar from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Hajar enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hajar by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Hajar face-up.
Resolve the Hajar ability from step 1.
Repeat.
